EstablishedHoldTimerExpiryRunsTheEvent10List additionally drives a running Peer and requireReleased demands exactly one 4/0, EOF and stopped timers; EstablishedHoldTimerFedByKeepalivesNeverExpires supplies KEEPALIVEs for three hold times and demands no NOTIFICATION, no close and the same live session. The peer timer alone starts unarmed, but the explicitly armed Session pair makes deletion of timer stopping observable.
